hardening.result: Read-only critics found three blockers during polish: email-only account replay rotated sessions, the production binary could boot without durable Postgres, and Postgres review apply checked stale schedule state before the transaction. The fixes reject duplicate account creation without a valid existing session, require MEMORY_ENGINE_POSTGRES_URL unless file storage is explicitly opted in, and move duplicate/prior-schedule checks under a review-unit row lock. A fresh targeted critic found no remaining blocking issue in those three classes.
